sections.title: Launch gets reliable
sections.dek: Two fixes stop the countdown from failing for no reason.

lead.label: Why it matters
lead.text: A missed spark used to scrub the whole launch.

cards.headline: The pad waits for the gyro
cards.plain: The clamps stay closed until guidance is steady.

cards.headline: The countdown is tested on every change
cards.plain: A test now runs the whole countdown each time code changes.

cards.headline: Boosters are called stages now
cards.plain: The word changes everywhere; nothing else does.
